versions.changelog:
First release.

- Sonarr and Radarr Webhook connections post to /ArrRefresh/Webhook.
- Imports, upgrades, renames and deletes update only the affected movie, series, season or episode. A library root is never refreshed.
- Replaced items hand their watch state, playlist entries and collection memberships to their successors, including every episode of a series that moved folders.
- Nothing is removed while its file exists or its share is offline.
- POST /ArrRefresh/Paths runs the same work on demand.

name: Arr Refresh
overview: Sonarr/Radarr webhooks update only the movie or episode that changed, never the whole library.
description: Point Sonarr's and Radarr's stock Webhook connection at /ArrRefresh/Webhook. On import, upgrade, rename and delete, the plugin resolves only the affected path: it creates or replaces the movie (or the series) under its existing parent, removes items whose files are gone, carries watch state and collection membership across a rename, and queues a metadata refresh for that item alone. Episodes refresh only their Season. Nothing ever re-validates a library root, so large libraries on slow or union filesystems are not walked on every change.
